    | project TimeGenerated, Computer=DvcHostname, EventSource="Registry", Detail=strcat(RegistryKey, " ", RegistryValue, "=", tostring(RegistryValueData)), ActingProcessName, ActorUsername ),
  ( SecurityEvent
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)

    | project TimeGenerated, Computer, EventSource="ServiceInstalled-4697", Detail=strcat(ServiceName, " -> ", ServiceFileName, " start=", ServiceStartType), ActingProcessName=ProcessName, ActorUsername=SubjectUserName ),

3588.sigma:
title: GlassWorm Force-Install of IDE Extension via cmd.exe --install-extension
id: 5b8f1cd9-2e0b-4d83-aa55-8b6f0c2e7f44
status: experimental
description: Detects the GlassWorm Zig dropper's IDE-infection routine that shells out via cmd.exe with the very specific flag combination /d /e:ON /v:OFF /c to invoke a VS Code-family CLI (code.cmd, code-insiders.cmd, cursor.cmd, windsurf.cmd, codium.cmd, positron.cmd) with --install-extension to silently install the second-stage autoimport-2.7.9.vsix into every IDE on the box.
references:
  - https://www.aikido.dev/blog/glassworm-zig-dropper-infects-every-ide-on-your-machine
  - https://thehackernews.com/2026/04/glassworm-campaign-uses-zig-dropper-to.html
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/05/13
tags:
  - attack.t1059.003
  - attack.t1195.002
  - attack.execution
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_img:
    Image|endswith: '\cmd.exe'
  selection_flags:
    CommandLine|contains|all:
      - '/d'
      - '/e:ON'
      - '/v:OFF'
      - '--install-extension'
  selection_ide_cli:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'code.cmd'
      - 'code-insiders.cmd'
      - 'cursor.cmd'
      - 'windsurf.cmd'
      - 'codium.cmd'
      - 'positron.cmd'
  filter_legit_parent:
    ParentImage|endswith:
      - '\explorer.exe'
      - '\msiexec.exe'
  condition: selection_img and selection_flags and selection_ide_cli and not filter_legit_parent
falsepositives:
  - Custom DevOps tooling that scripts VS Code extension provisioning. Validate against known build/automation hosts before alerting.
level: high
3588.spl: | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.process_name="cmd.exe" Processes.process="*--install-extension*" (Processes.process="*code.cmd*" OR Processes.process="*code-insiders.cmd*" OR Processes.process="*cursor.cmd*" OR Processes.process="*windsurf.cmd*" OR Processes.process="*codium.cmd*" OR Processes.process="*positron.cmd*") Processes.process="*/d*" Processes.process="*/e:ON*" Processes.process="*/v:OFF*" Processes.parent_process_name!="explorer.exe" by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.parent_process_name Processes.parent_process Processes.process_name Processes.process Processes.process_hash | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime)
3588.datadog: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 (@Image:(*\\cmd.exe OR *\\CMD.EXE OR *\\Cmd.exe)) @CommandLine:(*--install-extension*) @CommandLine:(*\/d*) @CommandLine:(*\/e\:ON*) @CommandLine:(*\/v\:OFF*) @CommandLine:(*code.cmd* OR *code-insiders.cmd* OR *cursor.cmd* OR *windsurf.cmd* OR *codium.cmd* OR *positron.cmd*) -@ParentImage:(*\\explorer.exe OR *\\EXPLORER.EXE)

id: f4dbe617-a089-4b1d-ce5f-4b5a6f7d8e9f
status: experimental
description: Detects the on-disk staging of tpcp.tar.gz — the exfiltration archive signature shared between the telnyx and litellm PyPI supply-chain compromises by TeamPCP. Encrypted with AES-256-CBC and RSA-4096 before exfil.
references:
  - https://www.stepsecurity.io/blog/teampcp-plants-wav-steganography-credential-stealer-in-telnyx-pypi-package
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/03/27
tags:
  - attack.exfiltration
  - attack.t1560.001
  - attack.t1041
  - attack.t1195.002
logsource:
  category: file_event
detection:
  selection:
    TargetFilename|endswith: 'tpcp.tar.gz'
  condition: selection
falsepositives:
  - IR / threat-hunting team intentionally collecting the IOC for analysis
  - Sandbox-replay environment regenerating the IOC for testing
level: critical
3601.spl: | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Filesystem.file_path) as paths values(Filesystem.process_name) as writer values(Filesystem.user) as user from datamodel=Endpoint.Filesystem where Filesystem.file_name="tpcp.tar.gz" by host | `drop_dm_object_name(Filesystem)` | `security_content_ctime(firstTime)` | `security_content_ctime(lastTime)`
3601.falcon:
#event_simpleName=FileWritten TargetFileName=/tpcp\.tar\.gz$/i
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, TargetFileName, ContextImageFileName, ContextProcessId, WrittenBytes], function=count())

3602.sigma:
title: Installation of Malicious telnyx PyPI Package (4.87.1 / 4.87.2)
id: a5ecf728-b19a-4c2e-df60-5c6b7f8e9fa0
status: experimental
description: Detects pip install of the compromised telnyx 4.87.1 or 4.87.2 PyPI releases backdoored by TeamPCP with a WAV-steganography credential stealer.
references:
  - https://www.stepsecurity.io/blog/teampcp-plants-wav-steganography-credential-stealer-in-telnyx-pypi-package
  - https://github.com/team-telnyx/telnyx-python/issues/235
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/03/27
tags:
  - attack.initial_access
  - attack.t1195.002
logsource:
  category: process_creation
detection:
  selection_pip:
    Image|endswith:
      - '/pip'
      - '/pip3'
      - '\\pip.exe'
      - '\\pip3.exe'
  selection_pymodule:
    Image|endswith:
      - '/python'
      - '/python3'
      - '\\python.exe'
      - '\\python3.exe'
    CommandLine|contains: '-m pip'
  selection_args:
    CommandLine|contains|all:
      - 'install'
      - 'telnyx'
  selection_version:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - '4.87.1'
      - '4.87.2'
  condition: (selection_pip or selection_pymodule) and selection_args and selection_version
falsepositives:
  - Security team intentionally installing the malicious version in a lab for analysis
  - SBOM / vulnerability scanner replaying installs in a sandbox
level: high
3602.spl: | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process) as cmdline values(Processes.parent_process_name) as parent from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.process_name IN ("pip","pip3","pip.exe","pip3.exe") OR Processes.process="*-m pip*") AND Processes.process="*install*" AND Processes.process="*telnyx*" AND (Processes.process="*4.87.1*" OR Processes.process="*4.87.2*") by host, user | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | `security_content_ctime(firstTime)`
3602.datadog: (source:linux.auditd OR source:windows.sysmon OR source:windows.security) (@process.command_line:(*"pip install"* AND *telnyx* AND (*4.87.1* OR *4.87.2*)) OR @CommandLine:(*"pip install"* AND *telnyx* AND (*4.87.1* OR *4.87.2*)) OR @CommandLine:(*"-m pip"* AND *install* AND *telnyx* AND (*4.87.1* OR *4.87.2*)))
3602.falcon:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2
| (ImageFileName=/pip(3)?(\.exe)?$/i OR (ImageFileName=/python(3)?(\.exe)?$/i AND CommandLine=/-m\s+pip/i))
| CommandLine=/install/i
| CommandLine=/telnyx/i
| CommandLine=/(4\.87\.1|4\.87\.2)/
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, CommandLine, ParentBaseFileName], function=count())

3603.sigma:
title: TeamPCP LiteLLM Compromised PyPI Install (1.82.7 / 1.82.8)
id: 8b3c54a1-9f2c-4e7c-a6b1-7f1d4b5a2e90
description: Detects pip/uv/poetry installing the malicious litellm 1.82.7 or 1.82.8 PyPI versions published by TeamPCP on 2026-03-24.
references:
  - https://securitylabs.datadoghq.com/articles/litellm-compromised-pypi-teampcp-supply-chain-campaign/
  - https://docs.litellm.ai/blog/security-update-march-2026
  - https://www.trendmicro.com/en_us/research/26/c/your-ai-stack-just-handed-over-your-root-keys-inside-the-litellm-pypi-breach.html
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/05/21
tags:
  - attack.initial_access
  - attack.t1195.002
  - attack.execution
  - attack.t1059.006
logsource:
  category: process_creation
detection:
  selection_img:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\pip.exe'
      - '\pip3.exe'
      - '\python.exe'
      - '\python3.exe'
      - '\uv.exe'
      - '\poetry.exe'
      - '/pip'
      - '/pip3'
      - '/python'
      - '/python3'
      - '/uv'
      - '/poetry'
  selection_cmd:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'litellm==1.82.7'
      - 'litellm==1.82.8'
      - 'litellm-1.82.7'
      - 'litellm-1.82.8'
  condition: selection_img and selection_cmd
falsepositives:
  - Forensic researcher pulling the IOC sample into a sandbox; whitelist by host
level: high
3603.spl: | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.process_name IN ("pip.exe","pip3.exe","pip","pip3","python.exe","python3.exe","python","python3","uv.exe","uv","poetry.exe","poetry")) AND (Processes.process="*litellm==1.82.7*" OR Processes.process="*litellm==1.82.8*" OR Processes.process="*litellm-1.82.7*" OR Processes.process="*litellm-1.82.8*") by host, user, Processes.process_name, Processes.process, Processes.parent_process_name | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | `security_content_ctime(firstTime)` | `security_content_ctime(lastTime)`
3603.datadog: (source:windows.security OR source:windows.sysmon OR source:linux.auditd) (@CommandLine:(*litellm==1.82.7* OR *litellm==1.82.8* OR *litellm-1.82.7* OR *litellm-1.82.8*) OR @process.command_line:(*litellm==1.82.7* OR *litellm==1.82.8* OR *litellm-1.82.7* OR *litellm-1.82.8*))
3603.falcon:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2
| (ImageFileName=/(pip|pip3|python|python3|uv|poetry)(\.exe)?$/i OR ParentBaseFileName=/(pip|pip3|python|python3|uv|poetry)(\.exe)?$/i)
| regex("litellm[=\\-]1\\.82\\.(7|8)", field=CommandLine)
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, ImageFileName, CommandLine], function=count())

description: Detects the creation of ~/.config/sysmon/sysmon.py or ~/.config/systemd/user/sysmon.service — Linux-side persistence dropped by malicious litellm 1.82.7/1.82.8.
references:
  - https://securitylabs.datadoghq.com/articles/litellm-compromised-pypi-teampcp-supply-chain-campaign/

author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/05/21
tags:

  - attack.t1543.002
  - attack.defense_evasion

logsource:
  product: linux
  category: file_event
detection:
  selection:
    TargetFilename|contains:
      - '/.config/sysmon/sysmon.py'
      - '/.config/systemd/user/sysmon.service'

// Hunts the actual binaries / paths / commandline fragments named
// in the article instead of a generic technique-class template.
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(30d)
| where (FileName in~ ("msbuild.exe", "_client.py") or FolderPath has_any ("%APPDATA%\Microsoft\Windows\Start"))
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FileName,
          FolderPath, ProcessCommandLine,
          InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine
| order by Timestamp desc

// File-creation events for the named binaries / paths
DeviceFileEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(30d)
| where ActionType in ("FileCreated","FileModified")
| where (FolderPath has_any ("%APPDATA%\Microsoft\Windows\Start") or FileName in~ ("msbuild.exe", "_client.py"))
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FolderPath,
          FileName, ActionType, InitiatingProcessFileName,
          InitiatingProcessCommandLine
| order by Timestamp desc
3626.spl:
``` Article-specific bespoke detection — Popular telnyx package compromised on PyPI by TeamPCP ```
| tstats `summariesonly` count earliest(_time) AS firstTime latest(_time) AS lastTime
    from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes
    where (Processes.process_name IN ("msbuild.exe","_client.py") OR Processes.process_path="*%APPDATA%\Microsoft\Windows\Start*")
    by Processes.dest, Processes.user, Processes.process_name,
       Processes.process, Processes.parent_process_name, Processes.process_path
| `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)`
| `security_content_ctime(firstTime)`
| append [
| tstats `summariesonly` count
    from datamodel=Endpoint.Filesystem
    where Filesystem.action IN ("created","modified")
      AND (Filesystem.file_path="*%APPDATA%\Microsoft\Windows\Start*" OR Filesystem.file_name IN ("msbuild.exe","_client.py"))
    by Filesystem.dest, Filesystem.user, Filesystem.process_name,
       Filesystem.file_path, Filesystem.file_name
| `drop_dm_object_name(Filesystem)`
]

3633.def:
let LookbackDays = 14d;
let JpLureSubjectFragments = dynamic(["従業員持株会","人事異動","給与改定","給与調整","税務コンプライアンス","罰金通知","持株会規約"]);
let ArchiveTypes = dynamic(["rar","zip","RAR","ZIP","7z","7Z"]);
let SuspectMail = EmailEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where EmailDirection == "Inbound"
    | where DeliveryAction in ("Delivered","DeliveredAsSpam")
    | where Subject contains "従業員持株会"
        or Subject contains "人事異動"
        or Subject contains "給与改定"
        or Subject contains "給与調整"
        or Subject contains "税務コンプライアンス"
        or Subject contains "罰金通知"
        or Subject contains "持株会規約"
    | project Timestamp, NetworkMessageId, SenderFromAddress, SenderMailFromAddress, SenderDisplayName, RecipientEmailAddress, Subject, AuthenticationDetails;
let UrlSide = SuspectMail
    | join kind=inner (
        EmailUrlInfo
        | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
        | where UrlDomain has_any ("gofile.io","wetransfer.com","we.tl")
        | project NetworkMessageId, Url, UrlDomain, UrlLocation
      ) on NetworkMessageId
    | extend Vector = strcat("URL:", UrlDomain), Indicator = Url;
let AttachSide = SuspectMail
    | join kind=inner (
        EmailAttachmentInfo
        | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
        | where FileType in~ (ArchiveTypes) or FileName endswith ".rar" or FileName endswith ".zip" or FileName endswith ".7z"
        | project NetworkMessageId, FileName, FileType, SHA256, FileSize
      ) on NetworkMessageId
    | extend Vector = strcat("ATTACH:", FileType), Indicator = FileName;
union UrlSide, AttachSide
| project Timestamp, RecipientEmailAddress, SenderFromAddress, SenderMailFromAddress, SenderDisplayName, Subject, Vector, Indicator, NetworkMessageId
| order by Timestamp desc

let _badDomain = "checkmarx.zone";
let _badIP = "83.142.209.11";
union isfuzzy=true
  ( DeviceNetworkEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(7d)
    | where RemoteUrl has _badDomain or RemoteIP == _badIP
    | project Timestamp, DeviceName, ActionType, RemoteIP, RemotePort, RemoteUrl,
              InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
              InitiatingProcessAccountName, InitiatingProcessFolderPath ),
  ( DeviceEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(7d)
    | where ActionType == "DnsQueryResponse"
    | extend Q = tostring(parse_json(AdditionalFields).QueryName)
    | where Q has _badDomain
    | project Timestamp, DeviceName, ActionType, RemoteUrl = Q,
              InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
              InitiatingProcessAccountName, InitiatingProcessFolderPath )
| order by Timestamp desc
3637.sent:
let _badDomain = "checkmarx.zone";
let _badIP = "83.142.209.11";
union isfuzzy=true
  ( CommonSecurityLog
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
    | where DestinationIP == _badIP
        or RequestURL has _badDomain
        or DestinationHostName has _badDomain
        or DestinationDnsDomain has _badDomain
    | project TimeGenerated, Src=SourceIP, Dst=DestinationIP, DstPort=DestinationPort,
              DstHost=DestinationHostName, Url=RequestURL, DeviceVendor, DeviceProduct ),
  ( DnsEvents

    | project TimeGenerated, DvcHostname, SrcIpAddr, DstIpAddr, DstPortNumber, DstHostname, Url ),
  ( Syslog
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
    | where SyslogMessage has _badDomain or SyslogMessage has _badIP
    | project TimeGenerated, Computer, HostIP, ProcessName, SyslogMessage )
| order by TimeGenerated desc

id: 7b3d2e4a-1c8f-4a72-9a83-2e9c5b1f0a3d
status: experimental
description: Detects creation of the TeamPCP supply-chain backdoor files dropped by the poisoned Checkmarx/kics-github-action and aquasecurity/trivy-action setup.sh — a python implant at ~/.config/sysmon/sysmon.py and a user-mode systemd unit ~/.config/systemd/user/sysmon.service that polls checkmarx.zone/raw for tasking.

  - https://www.stepsecurity.io/blog/checkmarx-kics-github-action-compromised-malware-injected-in-all-git-tags
  - https://www.wiz.io/blog/teampcp-attack-kics-github-action

description: Detects network egress to the C2 infrastructure used by the xygeni-action GitHub Action supply-chain compromise (March 2026 - tag-poisoned v5). The implant registers at POST /b/in then polls /b/q on security-verify.91.214.78.178.nip.io.
references:

  - attack.t1071.001
  - attack.t1090
  - attack.t1568.002

  product: linux

  selection_ip:
    DestinationIp: '91.214.78.178'
  selection_host:
    DestinationHostname|contains: '91.214.78.178.nip.io'
  condition: selection_ip or selection_host

3663.spl: | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Network_Traffic.All_Traffic where All_Traffic.dest="91.214.78.178" OR All_Traffic.dest_ip="91.214.78.178" OR All_Traffic.dest_host="*91.214.78.178.nip.io" OR All_Traffic.dest_host="security-verify.91.214.78.178.nip.io" OR All_Traffic.url="*91.214.78.178.nip.io*" by All_Traffic.src, All_Traffic.user, All_Traffic.app, All_Traffic.dest_ip, All_Traffic.dest_host, All_Traffic.dest_port, All_Traffic.url | `drop_dm_object_name(All_Traffic)` | convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime)

  product: linux

  selection_proc:
    Image|endswith:
      - '/curl'
      - '/wget'
  selection_fqdn:

3666.def:
// Article-specific bespoke detection — How a Poisoned Security Scanner Became the Key to Backdooring LiteLLM
// Hunts the actual binaries / paths / commandline fragments named
// in the article instead of a generic technique-class template.
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(30d)
| where (FileName in~ ("proxy_server.py", "sysmon.py"))
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FileName,
          FolderPath, ProcessCommandLine,
          InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine
| order by Timestamp desc

// File-creation events for the named binaries / paths
DeviceFileEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(30d)
| where ActionType in ("FileCreated","FileModified")
| where (FolderPath has_any ("/var/log/auth.log", "/etc/shadow", "/root/.config/sysmon/sysmon.py", "/tmp/pglog", "/tmp/.pg_state", "/dev/null", "/tmp/tpcp.tar.gz", "/tmp/session.key") or FileName in~ ("proxy_server.py", "sysmon.py"))
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FolderPath,
          FileName, ActionType, InitiatingProcessFileName,
          InitiatingProcessCommandLine
| order by Timestamp desc
3666.spl:
``` Article-specific bespoke detection — How a Poisoned Security Scanner Became the Key to Backdooring LiteLLM ```
| tstats `summariesonly` count earliest(_time) AS firstTime latest(_time) AS lastTime
    from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes
    where (Processes.process_name IN ("proxy_server.py","sysmon.py"))
    by Processes.dest, Processes.user, Processes.process_name,
       Processes.process, Processes.parent_process_name, Processes.process_path
| `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)`
| `security_content_ctime(firstTime)`
| append [
| tstats `summariesonly` count
    from datamodel=Endpoint.Filesystem
    where Filesystem.action IN ("created","modified")
      AND (Filesystem.file_path="*/var/log/auth.log*" OR Filesystem.file_path="*/etc/shadow*" OR Filesystem.file_path="*/root/.config/sysmon/sysmon.py*" OR Filesystem.file_path="*/tmp/pglog*" OR Filesystem.file_path="*/tmp/.pg_state*" OR Filesystem.file_path="*/dev/null*" OR Filesystem.file_path="*/tmp/tpcp.tar.gz*" OR Filesystem.file_path="*/tmp/session.key*" OR Filesystem.file_name IN ("proxy_server.py","sysmon.py"))
    by Filesystem.dest, Filesystem.user, Filesystem.process_name,
       Filesystem.file_path, Filesystem.file_name
| `drop_dm_object_name(Filesystem)`
]

id: 7a2c5e91-3b6d-4f8a-92c1-4d7b9e0c1f33
status: experimental
description: Sednit BeardShell implant uses Icedrive cloud storage for C2. Egress to icedrive.net by a non-browser process is high-confidence implant traffic.
references:
  - https://www.welivesecurity.com/en/eset-research/sednit-reloaded-back-trenches/
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/05/20
tags:
  - attack.t1102.002
  - attack.t1071.001
  - attack.g0007
logsource:
  category: network_connection
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    DestinationHostname|contains:
      - 'icedrive.net'
      - 'icedrive.com'
  filter_browser:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\chrome.exe'
      - '\msedge.exe'
      - '\firefox.exe'
      - '\brave.exe'
      - '\opera.exe'
      - '\iexplore.exe'
  condition: selection and not filter_browser
falsepositives:
  - User running Icedrive desktop sync client (rare in enterprise)
level: high
3720.spl: | tstats `summariesonly` count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(All_Traffic.dest) as dest values(All_Traffic.dest_port) as dest_port values(All_Traffic.app) as app from datamodel=Network_Traffic.All_Traffic where (All_Traffic.dest_host IN ("*.icedrive.net","*.icedrive.com","icedrive.net","icedrive.com") OR All_Traffic.url IN ("*icedrive.net*","*icedrive.com*")) AND NOT All_Traffic.app IN ("chrome.exe","msedge.exe","firefox.exe","brave.exe","opera.exe","iexplore.exe","safari.exe") by host All_Traffic.src All_Traffic.user All_Traffic.app | `drop_dm_object_name(All_Traffic)` | convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime)
3720.datadog: (source:windows.sysmon @EventID:3 (@DestinationHostname:(*icedrive.net* OR *icedrive.com*)) -@Image:(*\chrome.exe OR *\Chrome.exe OR *\msedge.exe OR *\MsEdge.exe OR *\firefox.exe OR *\Firefox.exe OR *\brave.exe OR *\Brave.exe OR *\opera.exe OR *\iexplore.exe)) OR (source:windows.defender @RemoteUrl:(*icedrive.net* OR *icedrive.com*))
3720.falcon:
((#event_simpleName=DnsRequest DomainName=/icedrive\.(net|com)$/i) OR (#event_simpleName=NetworkConnectIP4 (RemotePort=443 OR RemotePort=80)))
| NOT ContextImageFileName=/(chrome|msedge|firefox|brave|opera|iexplore|vivaldi|safari)\.exe$/i
| ContextImageFileName=*
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, ContextImageFileName, DomainName], function=[min(@timestamp), count()])

3721.def:
let Browsers = dynamic(["chrome.exe","msedge.exe","firefox.exe","brave.exe","opera.exe","iexplore.exe","safari.exe","vivaldi.exe","filen.exe"]);
DeviceNetworkEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(30d)
| where RemoteUrl has_any ("filen.io","filen.net") or RemoteUrl endswith ".filen.io" or RemoteUrl endswith ".filen.net"
| where not(InitiatingProcessFileName in~ (Browsers))
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, InitiatingProcessAccountName, InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessFolderPath, InitiatingProcessCommandLine, InitiatingProcessParentFileName, RemoteUrl, RemoteIP, RemotePort
| order by Timestamp desc
3721.sent:
let Browsers = dynamic(["Mozilla","Chrome","Safari","Edg/","Firefox","Vivaldi","OPR/"]);
union isfuzzy=true
(ImWebSession
  | where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
  | where Url has_any ("filen.io","filen.net") or HttpHostName has_any ("filen.io","filen.net")
  | where not(HttpRequestHeaderUserAgent has_any (Browsers))
  | project TimeGenerated, DvcHostname, SrcHostname, SrcIpAddr, SrcUsername, Url, HttpHostName, HttpRequestHeaderUserAgent, DstIpAddr),
(ImDnsActivity
  | where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
  | where DnsQuery has_any ("filen.io","filen.net")
  | project TimeGenerated, DvcHostname, SrcHostname, SrcIpAddr, SrcUsername, DnsQuery, DnsResponseName),
(CommonSecurityLog
  | where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
  | where (RequestURL has_any ("filen.io","filen.net")) or (DestinationHostName has_any ("filen.io","filen.net"))
  | where SourceProcessName != "" and not(SourceProcessName in~ ("chrome.exe","msedge.exe","firefox.exe","brave.exe","opera.exe","iexplore.exe","filen.exe"))
  | project TimeGenerated, SourceHostName, SourceUserName, SourceProcessName, RequestURL, DestinationHostName, DestinationIP)
| order by TimeGenerated desc

3722.sigma:
title: Sednit COM Hijacking Persistence HKCU CLSID InprocServer32
id: 6f1a3c84-5d8e-4b92-a0c3-7f9b1d4e2c55
status: experimental
description: BeardShell and SlimAgent persist via COM hijacking. Detects HKCU CLSID InprocServer32 (Default) value pointing to a DLL in a user-writable path or matching known Sednit DLL filenames.
references:
  - https://www.welivesecurity.com/en/eset-research/sednit-reloaded-back-trenches/
  - https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1546/015/
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/05/20
tags:
  - attack.t1546.015
  - attack.persistence
  - attack.g0007
logsource:
  category: registry_event
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_key:
    TargetObject|contains:
      - '\Software\Classes\CLSID\'
    TargetObject|endswith:
      - '\InprocServer32\(Default)'
      - '\InprocServer32'
  selection_value:
    Details|contains:
      - '\AppData\'
      - '\Users\Public\'
      - '\Windows\Temp\'
      - '\ProgramData\'
      - 'eapphost.dll'
      - 'tcpiphlpsvc.dll'
  condition: selection_key and selection_value
falsepositives:
  - User-scoped legitimate COM registration by an app installed under %AppData% (Slack, Teams, Spotify)
level: high
3722.spl: | tstats `summariesonly` count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Registry.registry_value_data) as registry_value_data values(Registry.user) as user values(Registry.process_name) as process_name from datamodel=Endpoint.Registry where Registry.registry_path IN ("*\\Software\\Classes\\CLSID\\*\\InprocServer32*") AND Registry.registry_hive="HKEY_USERS" AND (Registry.registry_value_data IN ("*\\AppData\\*","*\\Users\\Public\\*","*\\Temp\\*","*\\ProgramData\\*","*eapphost.dll*","*tcpiphlpsvc.dll*")) by host Registry.dest Registry.registry_path Registry.registry_value_name | `drop_dm_object_name(Registry)` | convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime)
3722.datadog: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:13 (@TargetObject:(*\Software\Classes\CLSID\*\InprocServer32* OR *\software\classes\clsid\*\inprocserver32*)) (@Details:(*\AppData\* OR *\appdata\* OR *\Users\Public\* OR *\Windows\Temp\* OR *\ProgramData\* OR *eapphost.dll* OR *EAPHOST.DLL* OR *tcpiphlpsvc.dll* OR *TCPIPHLPSVC.DLL*))
3722.falcon:
#event_simpleName=AsepValueUpdate
| regex("(?i)\\\\Software\\\\Classes\\\\CLSID\\\\", field=RegObjectName)
| regex("(?i)InprocServer32", field=RegObjectName)
| (regex("(?i)\\\\AppData\\\\", field=RegStringValue) OR regex("(?i)\\\\Users\\\\Public\\\\", field=RegStringValue) OR regex("(?i)\\\\Windows\\\\Temp\\\\", field=RegStringValue) OR regex("(?i)\\\\ProgramData\\\\", field=RegStringValue) OR regex("(?i)eapphost\\.dll", field=RegStringValue) OR regex("(?i)tcpiphlpsvc\\.dll", field=RegStringValue))
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, RegObjectName, RegStringValue, ContextImageFileName], function=[min(@timestamp), count()])

3723.def:
let ImplantDlls = dynamic(["eapphost.dll","tcpiphlpsvc.dll"]);
let UserWritablePaths = dynamic([@"\AppData\Local\", @"\AppData\Roaming\", @"\Windows\Temp\", @"\Users\Public\", @"\ProgramData\"]);

   or (InitiatingProcessFolderPath has_any (UserWritablePaths) and not(InitiatingProcessFileName in~ ("chrome.exe","msedge.exe","firefox.exe","notepad.exe","notepad++.exe","code.exe","outlook.exe","winword.exe","excel.exe","powerpnt.exe","teams.exe","slack.exe","onenote.exe")))
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, InitiatingProcessAccountName, InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessFolderPath, InitiatingProcessCommandLine, FileName, FolderPath, SHA1

3723.spl: | tstats `summariesonly` count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Filesystem.file_path) as file_path values(Filesystem.process_name) as process_name values(Filesystem.user) as user from datamodel=Endpoint.Filesystem where (Filesystem.file_name IN ("*.html","*.htm","*.log","*.dat")) AND (Filesystem.file_path IN ("*\\AppData\\Local\\*","*\\AppData\\Roaming\\*","*\\Windows\\Temp\\*","*\\Users\\Public\\*","*\\ProgramData\\*")) AND (Filesystem.process_name IN ("svchost.exe","rundll32.exe","regsvr32.exe") OR Filesystem.process IN ("*eapphost.dll*","*tcpiphlpsvc.dll*")) by host Filesystem.dest Filesystem.file_name Filesystem.process_id | `drop_dm_object_name(Filesystem)` | convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime)
3723.datadog: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:11 (@TargetFilename:(*.html OR *.htm OR *.log OR *.dat)) (@TargetFilename:(*\AppData\* OR *\appdata\* OR *\Windows\Temp\* OR *\Users\Public\* OR *\ProgramData\*)) (@CommandLine:(*eapphost.dll* OR *EAPHOST.DLL* OR *tcpiphlpsvc.dll* OR *TCPIPHLPSVC.DLL*) OR @Image:(*\svchost.exe OR *\rundll32.exe OR *\regsvr32.exe))

| (regex("(?i)\\\\(svchost|rundll32|regsvr32)\\.exe$", field=ContextImageFileName) OR NOT regex("(?i)\\\\(chrome|msedge|firefox|notepad|code|outlook|winword|excel|powerpnt|teams|slack|onenote)\\.exe$", field=ContextImageFileName))
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, ContextImageFileName, TargetFileName], function=[min(@timestamp), count()])

3724.def:
// Article-specific bespoke detection — The 89% Problem: How LLMs Are Resurrecting the "Dormant Majority" of Open Source
// Hunts the actual binaries / paths / commandline fragments named
// in the article instead of a generic technique-class template.
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(30d)
| where (FileName in~ ("next.js"))
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FileName,
          FolderPath, ProcessCommandLine,
          InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine
| order by Timestamp desc

// File-creation events for the named binaries / paths
DeviceFileEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(30d)
| where ActionType in ("FileCreated","FileModified")
| where (FileName in~ ("next.js"))
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FolderPath,
          FileName, ActionType, InitiatingProcessFileName,
          InitiatingProcessCommandLine
| order by Timestamp desc
3724.spl:
``` Article-specific bespoke detection — The 89% Problem: How LLMs Are Resurrecting the "Dormant Majority" of Open Source ```
| tstats `summariesonly` count earliest(_time) AS firstTime latest(_time) AS lastTime
    from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes
    where (Processes.process_name IN ("next.js"))
    by Processes.dest, Processes.user, Processes.process_name,
       Processes.process, Processes.parent_process_name, Processes.process_path
| `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)`
| `security_content_ctime(firstTime)`
| append [
| tstats `summariesonly` count
    from datamodel=Endpoint.Filesystem
    where Filesystem.action IN ("created","modified")
      AND (Filesystem.file_name IN ("next.js"))
    by Filesystem.dest, Filesystem.user, Filesystem.process_name,
       Filesystem.file_path, Filesystem.file_name
| `drop_dm_object_name(Filesystem)`
]

3726.sigma:
title: Storybook WebSocket Injection - Malicious .stories File Write (CVE-2026-27148)
id: 8c5e6a4d-2f1b-4c7e-9a3d-1b5e8f2c4d6a
description: Detects creation of a Storybook .stories.{ts,tsx,js,jsx} file whose name contains JavaScript injection markers - the on-disk signature of CVE-2026-27148 exploitation. Storybook's unauthenticated dev-server WebSocket writes attacker-controlled componentFilePath into the project tree, embedding the payload directly in the filename.
references:
  - https://www.aikido.dev/blog/storybooks-websockets-attack
  - https://github.com/storybookjs/storybook/security/advisories/GHSA-mjf5-7g4m-gx5w
  - https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-27148
author: Detection Engineering
date: 2026/05/20
tags:
  - attack.initial_access
  - attack.t1190
  - attack.execution
  - attack.t1059.007
  - cve.2026.27148
logsource:
  category: file_event
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_path:
    TargetFilename|contains:
      - '\src\stories\'
      - '/src/stories/'
  selection_ext:
    TargetFilename|endswith:
      - '.ts'
      - '.tsx'
      - '.js'
      - '.jsx'
  selection_markers:
    TargetFilename|contains:
      - "';"
      - 'alert('
      - 'require('
      - 'child_process'
      - 'process.env'
      - 'execSync'
      - 'document.domain'
      - 'RCE_PROOF'
  filter_node_modules:
    TargetFilename|contains:
      - '\node_modules\'
      - '/node_modules/'
  condition: selection_path and selection_ext and selection_markers and not filter_node_modules
falsepositives:
  - Penetration tests against the dev environment
  - Security researcher reproducing the PoC on their own workstation
level: high
3726.spl: | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Endpoint.Filesystem where Filesystem.action=created (Filesystem.file_path="*\\src\\stories\\*" OR Filesystem.file_path="*/src/stories/*") (Filesystem.file_name="*.stories.ts*" OR Filesystem.file_name="*.stories.js*" OR Filesystem.file_name="*.stories.tsx" OR Filesystem.file_name="*.stories.jsx") (Filesystem.file_name="*';*" OR Filesystem.file_name="*alert(*" OR Filesystem.file_name="*require(*" OR Filesystem.file_name="*child_process*" OR Filesystem.file_name="*process.env*" OR Filesystem.file_name="*execSync*" OR Filesystem.file_name="*document.domain*" OR Filesystem.file_name="*RCE_PROOF*") by host Filesystem.file_path Filesystem.file_name Filesystem.process_name Filesystem.user | `drop_dm_object_name(Filesystem)` | convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime)
3726.falcon:
#event_simpleName=FileWritten
| regex("(/|\\\\)src(/|\\\\)stories(/|\\\\)", field=TargetFileName)
| TargetFileName=/\.stories\.(ts|tsx|js|jsx)$/i
| regex("('\\;|alert\\(|require\\(|child_process|process\\.env|execSync|document\\.domain|RCE_PROOF)", field=TargetFileName)
| NOT regex("(/|\\\\)node_modules(/|\\\\)", field=TargetFileName)
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, TargetFileName, ContextImageFileName], function=count())

          InitiatingProcessCommandLine
| order by Timestamp desc
